scripts.docker:clean: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml down -v --rmi local 2>nul || docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml down -v --rmi local 2>nul
scripts.docker:ps: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml ps 2>nul || docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml ps 2>nul
scripts.docker:init-db: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml --env-file .env.development run --rm -e DB_HOST=sqlserver api-gateway npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register docker/init-database.ts
scripts.docker:infra:ps: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml ps 2>nul || docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml ps 2>nul
scripts.docker:dev:restart: npm run docker:dev:down && npm run docker:dev:up
scripts.docker:dev:logs:gateway: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml --env-file .env.development logs -f api-gateway
scripts.docker:dev:rebuild: npm run docker:dev:down && npm run docker:dev:build && npm run docker:dev:up
scripts.docker:staging:build: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml build --env-file .env.staging
scripts.docker:staging:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging up -d
scripts.docker:staging:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml down
scripts.docker:staging:restart: npm run docker:staging:down && npm run docker:staging:up
scripts.docker:staging:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging logs -f
scripts.docker:staging:logs:gateway: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging logs -f api-gateway
scripts.docker:staging:rebuild: npm run docker:staging:down && npm run docker:staging:build && npm run docker:staging:up
scripts.docker:prod:build: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml build --env-file .env.production
scripts.docker:prod:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production up -d
scripts.docker:prod:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml down
scripts.docker:prod:restart: npm run docker:prod:down && npm run docker:prod:up
scripts.docker:prod:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production logs -f
scripts.docker:prod:logs:gateway: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production logs -f api-gateway
scripts.docker:prod:rebuild: npm run docker:prod:down && npm run docker:prod:build && npm run docker:prod:up
scripts.docker:prod:pull: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml pull
